The bow of Avarosa that Ashe brought back to the village was proof that the legendary Freljord queen had recognized her as the Frost Archer and bestowed her blessing. It goes without saying that no one dared to doubt her authority as chieftain after that. The reason Ashe's tribe prospered to the point of becoming the largest force in the Freljord and was eventually called the Avarosa tribe was not just because she possessed the weapon of the legendary queen, but also because of Ashe's efforts to peacefully unify the Freljord. Now, under the great name of Avarosa, Ashe is resolutely and steadily executing her vision of unifying all the tribes of the Freljord to create a powerful nation.

"One tribe, one people, for a great Freljord!"
-- Ashe

ja_JP.title: 狂戦士
ja_JP.lore:
普通の人間であれば死を恐れるが、オラフだけは例外だ。この乱暴な狂戦士は、ただ沸き上がる戦場の叫び声と武器がぶつかり合う轟音を聞くために生きている。彼が死よりも恐れるのは、老いて病み、孤独に忘れ去られること、そして平凡に死んでいくことだ。絶えず戦場の栄誉を切望して生きる彼だけに、戦闘が始まれば決して身を惜しむことはない。オラフの内面深奥には血に対する渇望が溶岩のように煮えたぎっており、彼は死の淵で戦う時のみ、真に生きていることを実感する。

沿岸半島ロクファールは、フレヨルドの中でも最も過酷な場所として悪名高い。この地で凍らずに流れる液体といえば血しかなく、ただ燃え上がる怒りだけが凍りついた体を温めてくれる。ロクファールの戦士オラフは戦場で数々の功績を上げてきたし、どんな場所でも自分の武勇伝を語るのが好きな豪放な男だった。その晩も部族の人々を一箇所に集めては、ある村をめちゃくちゃにして焼き払った話を続けているところだった。ところが、オラフの長広舌に飽き飽きした老兵の一人が彼に近づいてきて、果たしてこのように勝ち進む運命を続けられるのか、一度占ってみてはどうだとけしかけた。これにカッとなったオラフは、老いぼれた戦士が嫉妬深いだけだとせせら笑い、死ぬまでにどれほどの功績を上げられるか期待していろと言って、死んだ獣の骨を放り投げた。そして次の瞬間、占いをする仲間たちの顔から笑みが消え去ってしまった。その占いは、オラフが天寿を全うし、静かに息を引き取ると告げていたのだ。

普通の人なら誰でもそんな人生を夢見ていただろうが、オラフにとってそれ以上の屈辱はなかった。彼は一瞬、怒りで理性を失い、ロクファールで悪名高かったフロスト・サーペントを打ち倒して予言が間違っていることを証明してみせると言い残し、漆黒の闇の中へと飛び出した。フロスト・サーペントは長い年月、数多くの人間と船を飲み込んできた怪物であり、これくらいの相手と戦って死ぬなら戦士にふさわしい最期になるはずだった。ついにオラフはサーペントを発見し、黒い巨大な口に向けて荒々しく身を投げ出し、激しい戦闘の末、意識が途切れていくのを感じた。どれくらい時間が経っただろうか？ 彼は氷のように冷たい水の中でハッと意識を取り戻し、闇の中で目を開くと、彼の傍らには無残に切り刻まれた怪物の死体が浮かんでいた。彼は栄誉ある戦場の炎の中で死ぬことに失敗したという挫折感に、もう一度咆哮した。しかし、ここで諦めるつもりはなく、次の戦闘こそが自分の最期を飾ってくれるという希望を持って、悪名高い怪物という怪物を片っ端から探し回り始めた。しかし、彼が死を渇望して身を投げ出すたびに怒りの力が発動し、そのため栄誉ある死への期待はことごとく水の泡となってしまった。

オラフは、もはや一介の怪物ごときでは戦士らしい死を迎えさせてはくれないという結論に達した。ならば残された最後の道は、フレヨルドで最も凶暴なウィンタークロウ族を討つことだけ。ウィンタークロウ族長セジュアニは、オラフの大胆な挑戦を内心面白いと思っていたが、かといって彼に慈悲をかけるつもりは毛頭なかった。セジュアニの突撃命令で数十人の戦士が襲いかかり、オラフは血への渇望に包まれて狂暴な攻撃を浴びせ始めた。彼らを一人ずつ倒していったオラフは、いつの間にかセジュアニの目の前までたどり着き、二人は吹雪が吹き荒れる雪原でついに一対一で対峙することになった。やがてオラフとセジュアニの激突に氷河まで揺れ動いた。ところが、これはどうしたことか？ 休むことなく攻撃するこの狂戦士を、セジュアニはその場から軽々と受け止めていたのだ。そして相手を射抜くような眼差しだけで、これまでどんな武器でも成功しなかったオラフの狂戦士としての怒りを鎮めてしまった。セジュアニは怒りの気が弱まった隙に一つの提案を持ちかけ、それは自分の大征伐計画を助けてくれるなら、その対価としてオラフが切望する栄誉ある死を与えるというものだった。そしてこの瞬間、オラフはフレヨルドの歴史に自分の名を永遠に刻み込むと誓った。

「あの世で先祖たちに会ったら、オラフが送ったと言え。」
-- オラフ

en_US.title: The Berserker
en_US.lore:
Normal humans fear death, but Olaf is the exception. This violent berserker lives only to hear the boiling roar of the battlefield and the thunderous sound of weapons clashing. What he fears more than death is growing old and sick, being lonely and forgotten, and dying an ordinary death. Living with a constant craving for the honor of the battlefield, he never spares himself when a fight breaks out. Deep within Olaf, a thirst for blood boils like lava, and he only feels truly alive when he fights on the threshold of death.

The coastal peninsula of Lokfar is notorious for being the harshest place in the Freljord. In this land, the only liquid that flows without freezing is blood, and only burning rage warms a frozen body. Olaf, a warrior of Lokfar, has achieved numerous feats on the battlefield and was a boisterous man who loved to boast of his exploits anywhere. That evening, he was gathering the tribespeople together and telling the story of how he had ravaged and burned a village to the ground. However, an old veteran, tired of Olaf's long-windedness, approached him and suggested it would be a good idea to predict whether he would be able to continue his triumphant destiny like this. Offended, Olaf laughed at the old warrior for being merely jealous, threw a bone of a dead beast, and told him to wait and see how many feats he could achieve before he died. And in the next moment, the smiles vanished from the faces of his companions reading the omen. The omen told that Olaf would enjoy a long and healthy life and pass away quietly.

Any normal person would have dreamed of such a life, but for Olaf, there was no greater shame than that. He lost his reason in a fit of rage, said he would prove the prophecy wrong by defeating the frost serpent, which was notorious in Lokfar, and ran out into the pitch-black darkness. The frost serpent was a monster that had swallowed countless humans and ships over a long period of time, and dying while fighting something of this caliber would be a fitting end for a warrior. Finally, Olaf found the serpent, threw his body roughly toward its pitch-black jaws, and felt his consciousness fading after a fierce battle. How much time had passed? He snapped to his senses in the ice-cold water, opened his eyes in the darkness, and the corpse of the horribly mangled monster was floating beside him. He howled again in frustration at having failed to die honorably in the flames of the battlefield. However, he had no intention of giving up here, so he began to search for every notorious monster, hoping that the next battle would grace his final moments. But every time he threw himself with a longing for death, the power of rage was activated, and because of this, his expectations for a glorious death were dashed time and time again.

Olaf reached the conclusion that a mere monster could not grant him a warrior's death. Then, the only path left was to strike the Winter's Claw, the most ferocious tribe in the Freljord. Sejuani, the chieftain of the Winter's Claw, thought Olaf's bold challenge was secretly amusing, but she had no intention of showing him mercy. At Sejuani's command to charge, dozens of warriors rushed in, and Olaf, consumed by a thirst for blood, began to unleash a frenzied attack. Olaf, taking them down one by one, soon reached Sejuani, and the two finally faced off one-on-one on the snowfield where a blizzard was raging. Soon, the clash between Olaf and Sejuani shook even the glaciers. But how did this happen? Sejuani was easily enduring this berserker who was attacking without pause. And with just her eyes piercing the opponent, she broke Olaf's berserker fury, which no weapon had ever succeeded in doing before. Sejuani made an offer while his rage was weak, and it was that if he helped her with her great conquest plan, she would grant him the honorable death he so desired in return. And at this very moment, Olaf swore that he would leave his name in the history of the Freljord forever.

"When you see the ancestors in the afterlife, tell them Olaf sent you."
-- Olaf
